## Prefixes

- `foaf:` <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> — `foaf:Person` for alumni, `foaf:Organization` for groups.
- `schema:` <http://schema.org/> (http, not https) — `schema:birthDate`, `schema:deathDate`.
- `bioc:` <http://ldf.fi/schema/bioc/> — family relations; the relation type names the relative's role.

## Names and dates

Names are in `skos:prefLabel` as "Surname, Firstnames". Places have no labels.
Dates are `xsd:date` literals.
